text: CALL TO ORDER: 9:45 a.m. Speaker Nunziata took the Chair and called the Members to order. The meeting opened with O Canada. July 19, 2023 Members of Council observed a moment of silence and reflected on the announcement of the discovery of 88 potential graves at the at the former site of the St. Bruno's Indian Residential School in Joussard, Alberta. Members of Council observed a moment of silence and remembered: Helen Ainslie Elizabeth Eayrs Syd Gladstone Phillip Gotlieb Caroline Huebner-Makurat Sue Johanson Mira Koschitzky Coreen Joan Lewis Richard Morris Beverley Salmon Peter Thevarajan, and Victims of the Dauphin, Manitoba Bus Accident. Speaker Nunziata addressed Council as follows: I would like to take a moment on behalf of Council to acknowledge the Indigenous Peoples of all the lands that we are on today.
